representation.partial_assignment: A Finset V of fixed coordinates and a total base assignment; only its values on that Finset matter.
representation.subcube: subcube F a = Finset.univ.filter (fun x => forall v in F, x v = a v)
representation.compatibility: Compatible F a C b := forall v, v in F -> v in C -> a v = b v
representation.budget: (C \ F).card <= q; no bound on the already-fixed overlap is charged

cardinality_equivalence.name: PromiseCounting.subcubeEquiv
cardinality_equivalence.type: {x : V → Bool // x ∈ subcube F a} ≃ (↥(Fᶜ) → Bool)
cardinality_equivalence.forward: Restrict a completion to the complement of F.
cardinality_equivalence.inverse: Use a on F and the supplied Boolean function off F.

certificate.definition: PromiseCounting.IsCertificate A F a q x C b
fields: forall y, y ∈ subcube F a -> y ∈ subcube C b -> A y
certificate.consistency: Derived from the common anchor x; not assumed silently.
certificate.forcing_semantics: Every Boolean completion satisfying both partial assignments is accepted, not merely selected or promised completions.

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.mem_subcube
theorems.statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_subcube {F : Finset V} {a x : V → Bool} :
    x ∈ subcube F a ↔ ∀ v ∈ F, x v = a v

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.card_subcube
theorems.statement:
theorem card_subcube (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool) :
    (subcube F a).card = 2 ^ Fᶜ.card

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.compatible_of_common_point
theorems.statement:
theorem compatible_of_common_point (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool)
    (C : Finset V) (b x : V → Bool)
    (hxF : x ∈ subcube F a) (hxC : x ∈ subcube C b) : Compatible F a C b

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.subcube_inter_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem subcube_inter_eq (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool) (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool)
    (hc : Compatible F a C b) :
    subcube F a ∩ subcube C b =
      subcube (F ∪ C) (fun v => if v ∈ F then a v else b v)

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.free_after_union
theorems.statement:
theorem free_after_union (F C : Finset V) :
    (F ∪ C)ᶜ.card = Fᶜ.card - (C \ F).card

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.card_subcube_inter
theorems.statement:
theorem card_subcube_inter (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool) (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool)
    (hc : Compatible F a C b) :
    (subcube F a ∩ subcube C b).card = 2 ^ (Fᶜ.card - (C \ F).card)

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.card_subcube_inter_lower
theorems.statement:
theorem card_subcube_inter_lower (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool)
    (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool) (hc : Compatible F a C b)
    (q : Nat) (hq : (C \ F).card ≤ q) :
    2 ^ (Fᶜ.card - q) ≤ (subcube F a ∩ subcube C b).card

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.accepted_subcube_card_le
theorems.statement:
theorem accepted_subcube_card_le (A : (V → Bool) → Prop) (Low : Finset (V → Bool))
    (hLow : ∀ x, A x → x ∈ Low) (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool)
    (haccept : ∀ x ∈ subcube F a, A x) : (subcube F a).card ≤ Low.card

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.accepted_inter_card_le
theorems.statement:
theorem accepted_inter_card_le (A : (V → Bool) → Prop) (Low : Finset (V → Bool))
    (hLow : ∀ x, A x → x ∈ Low) (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool)
    (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool)
    (haccept : ∀ x, x ∈ subcube F a → x ∈ subcube C b → A x) :
    (subcube F a ∩ subcube C b).card ≤ Low.card

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.outside_low_completion
theorems.statement:
theorem outside_low_completion (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool)
    (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool) (hc : Compatible F a C b)
    (q : Nat) (hq : (C \ F).card ≤ q) (Low : Finset (V → Bool))
    (hsmall : Low.card < 2 ^ (Fᶜ.card - q)) :
    ∃ x : V → Bool, x ∈ subcube F a ∧ x ∈ subcube C b ∧ x ∉ Low

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.rejected_completion
theorems.statement:
theorem rejected_completion (A : (V → Bool) → Prop) (Low : Finset (V → Bool))
    (hLow : ∀ x, A x → x ∈ Low) (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool)
    (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool) (hc : Compatible F a C b)
    (q : Nat) (hq : (C \ F).card ≤ q) (hsmall : Low.card < 2 ^ (Fᶜ.card - q)) :
    ∃ x : V → Bool, x ∈ subcube F a ∧ x ∈ subcube C b ∧ x ∉ Low ∧ ¬ A x

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.certificate_count_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem certificate_count_bound (A : (V → Bool) → Prop) (Low : Finset (V → Bool))
    (hLow : ∀ x, A x → x ∈ Low) (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool)
    (q : Nat) (x : V → Bool) (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool)
    (hcert : IsCertificate A F a q x C b) : 2 ^ (Fᶜ.card - q) ≤ Low.card

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.no_certificate_of_card_lt
theorems.statement:
theorem no_certificate_of_card_lt (A : (V → Bool) → Prop) (Low : Finset (V → Bool))
    (hLow : ∀ x, A x → x ∈ Low) (F : Finset V) (a : V → Bool) (q : Nat)
    (hsmall : Low.card < 2 ^ (Fᶜ.card - q)) :
    ¬ ∃ (x : V → Bool) (C : Finset V) (b : V → Bool), IsCertificate A F a q x C b

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.flipAt_mem_subcube
theorems.statement:
theorem flipAt_mem_subcube (F : Finset V) (x : V → Bool) (i : V) (hi : i ∉ F) :
    flipAt x i ∈ subcube F x

theorems.name: PromiseCounting.isolated_yes_certificate_full
theorems.statement:
theorem isolated_yes_certificate_full (C : (V → Bool) → Bool) (x : V → Bool)
    (_hyes : C x = true) (hneighbors : ∀ i : V, C (flipAt x i) = false)
    (F : Finset V) (hforces : ∀ y : V → Bool, (∀ i ∈ F, y i = x i) → C y = true) :
    F = Finset.univ

counting_scope.exact_intersection_cardinality_under_com: (subcube F a ∩ subcube C b).card = 2 ^ (Fᶜ.card - (C \ F).card)
counting_scope.lower_bound: Compatible F a C b and (C \ F).card <= q imply 2^(r-q) <= intersection.card, where r = Fᶜ.card.
counting_scope.only_low_soundness_assumption: forall x, A x -> x ∈ Low
counting_scope.accepted_upper_bound: An all-accepted subcube, or all-accepted intersection of two subcubes, has cardinality <= Low.card.
counting_scope.outside_low_witness: If Low.card < 2^(r-q), compatibility and the new-coordinate budget produce a common completion outside Low without any hypothesis about A.
counting_scope.rejected_witness: Adding A-subset-Low soundness yields the same completion with not A x.
counting_scope.certificate_obstruction: Under A-subset-Low soundness and Low.card < 2^(r-q), no IsCertificate at any accepted common anchor exists.
counting_scope.no_hidden_low_equality: The proof does not assume A x iff x ∈ Low or that every point of Low is accepted.
boundary_cases: q greater than r (natural subtraction saturates at zero)

isolated_yes_scope.flip: flipAt x i j = if j = i then !(x i) else x j
assumptions: forall i, C (flipAt x i) = false
forall y, (forall i in F, y i = x i) -> C y = true
isolated_yes_scope.yes_hypothesis_note: The explicit C x = true hypothesis is retained for the intended setting; forcing already implies it by choosing y=x.
isolated_yes_scope.concrete_family_not_formalized: No claims about MCSP[0,0], constants/projections, pairwise distances, or DNF classifier size are checked here.

limitations: Low is an abstract finite set with explicit one-way soundness from acceptance. Circuit size and a size-threshold definition of Low are not formalized.
The checked witness is outside Low and, under soundness, not accepted. Calling it a promised NO instance additionally requires the application to identify outside-Low inputs with its NO region.
No logarithmic/asymptotic description-count bound is proved.
No algorithmic resource bound implies short certificates in this file; that is a separate missing application step.
The isolated-YES theorem is abstract and does not certify the proposed concrete negative-control family.
No OAI imports, full comparator rerun, or P versus NP conclusion.
